title: CraftToMuck: Aeronautics
description: This is a testing modpack for the CraftToMuck network. This modpack is built around Create Aeronautics, designed to explore and stress-test multiplayer performance in a modded environment.
body:
This is a testing modpack for the CraftToMuck network. This modpack is built around Create Aeronautics, designed to explore and stress-test multiplayer performance in a modded environment.

For the initial version, expect a lightweight modpack with a few create addons and building mods.
